description: This shell script automates the setup, testing, and verification of svn repository merging behavior within a git-svn environment. It includes initialization of svn repositories, creation of branches, merging, and cloning via git-svn, primarily to test merge detection and integration.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, wraps a series of shell commands to verify specific behavior.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution and reports results.
